The switch config XML fixture is a projection of the native `primary.cfg` downloaded by SFTP from
ExtremeXOS VM 33.6.1.14 (EXOS-VM, 33.6.1.14) on 2026-11-18. It preserves the platform, version, checksum
header fields and top-level module names. All module contents and remaining header fields
were removed at capture. The fixture is only a parser input.
